BrochureContent.Content:
Stylish top-floor living with exceptional views and South facing balcony    

Russell Estate Agents are delighted to present No. 19 Beechdale Court, a beautifully presented two-bedroom, two-bathroom top-floor apartment enjoying a particularly attractive corner position within the established Beechdale Court development in Ballycullen.  Extending to approximately 689 sq. ft. / 64 sq. m., the property offers well-balanced accommodation, excellent natural light and an exceptional level of storage. The own-door entrance adds a welcome sense of privacy and independence.  

Presented in excellent walk-in condition, the apartment has been thoughtfully maintained and provides a bright and comfortable home. A standout feature is the South-facing private balcony, which enjoys an elevated outlook towards Dublin city, the Dublin Mountains and the landscaped communal grounds.  The storage space in the entrance hall is another significant advantage, providing generous additional storage that is rarely available in apartment living.  

Features Two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment Top-floor position 
Own-door entrance Approximately 689 sq. ft. 
Private South facing balcony 
Panoramic views towards Dublin city and the Dublin Mountains 
Built-in wardrobes to both bedrooms 
Master bedroom with ensuite 
Generous open-plan living and dining space 
Fully fitted kitchen with integrated appliances
Ample communal parking 
Well-maintained landscaped grounds 
Management fee approximately €1,356 per annum 
Built in 2005 
Excellent transport connections 
Convenient access to the M50 and surrounding road network   

Accommodation 
Entrance Hall 
A welcoming entrance hall with attractive laminate flooring continuing through much of the apartment. The hallway incorporates useful storage, a shelved hot press.  

Living / Dining Room 
A particularly bright and spacious reception room providing excellent proportions for both living and dining. Generous natural light enhances the sense of space.  A generous bay window offers stunning views.

Kitchen 
A well-appointed kitchen fitted with shaker-style wall and floor units, tiled splashback and timber flooring. Integrated appliances include a washing machine and dishwasher, fridge/freezer, electric oven and four-ring electric hob.  

Master Bedroom 
A comfortable double bedroom featuring extensive four-door built-in wardrobe storage and the added benefit of a private ensuite.  Ensuite Fitted with tiled flooring, WC, wash hand basin and shower enclosure with electric shower. A vanity mirror and shaving light complete the room. 

 Bedroom Two 
A well-proportioned second double bedroom with four-door built-in wardrobe and direct access through sliding glazed doors to the private west-facing balcony.  Being positioned at the end of the row, the apartment enjoys an attractive degree of privacy together with an open outlook.  Family 

Bathroom 
A bright bathroom finished with tiled flooring and tiled surrounds, comprising WC, wash hand basin and bath with shower attachment. Vanity mirror and shaving light provided.  

Outdoor Space South-Facing Private Balcony.  Its South-facing orientation makes it an ideal space for enjoying afternoon and evening light, while the elevated position provides attractive panoramic views over Dublin city, the Dublin Mountains and the beautifully maintained communal gardens. 

Beechdale Court is a mature and well-established residential development situated in the heart of Ballycullen.  The development benefits from well-maintained communal grounds, generous communal parking and an attractive residential setting. The property itself is presented in excellent condition and offers an appealing combination of space, privacy and convenience. Ballycullen has established itself as one of South Dublin's most popular residential areas, offering an excellent blend of suburban tranquillity, everyday convenience and accessibility to Dublin city and surrounding employment centres. A wide selection of amenities is available close by, including Lidl Ballycullen, Oldcourt Shopping Centre, Old Bawn Shopping Centre and SuperValu Firhouse, alongside cafés, restaurants, local shops and a variety of essential services.  

For those who enjoy the outdoors, the area is particularly well served. Ballycragh Park, the Dublin Mountains and the Hell Fire Club are all within easy reach, with numerous scenic walking routes and recreational opportunities available throughout the surrounding area.  Marlay Park is also readily accessible, offering extensive green space, sporting facilities, markets and a programme of seasonal events and concerts. The area is home to a strong sporting community, with clubs and facilities including St Anne's GAA and Ballyboden St Enda's nearby.  

 Commuters are exceptionally well catered for, with a selection of Dublin Bus services operating within walking distance, including the 65B, 15, 15B, 175 and 49 routes. The 15 provides a 24-hour service, offering additional convenience for city commuters. The Luas Red Line is also accessible from the area, while the M50 at Firhouse provides a direct connection to Dublin's wider road network and onward routes throughout the city and beyond.   The surrounding area offers an excellent choice of primary and secondary educational facilities.  Nearby schools include:  Holy Rosary National School Firhouse Educate Together National School Gaelscoil na Giúise Firhouse Community College TU Dublin Tallaght Campus is also only a short drive away.  No. 19 Beechdale Court represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious and beautifully maintained apartment in a highly convenient South Dublin location.  The combination of top-floor privacy, own-door access, generous accommodation, two double bedrooms, two bathrooms and a superb South-facing balcony with panoramic views gives this property a particularly attractive proposition.  For first-time buyers, downsizers, investors or those seeking a well-connected Dublin base, this is a home to view.  

Viewing  Early viewing is strongly recommended to appreciate the quality, proportions, storage and exceptional outlook offered by this property.
